title: feature/evals family composite integration
objective: Extend the canonical feature/knowledge-g evidence-to-publication system with the strongest compatible controls from the frozen feature/evals-A through N family without creating a competing knowledge bank, weakening boundaries, or simulating external authority.

selection_order: invalid graph state or stale judgment

hard_constraints: The feature/evals-A through N refs remain read-only research inputs.
The feature/knowledge-g typed graph, approval register, readiness ledger, and publication model remain canonical.
Raw private archives, credentials, local paths, authenticated state, and unapproved media remain outside Git.
Epistemic, publication, and selection states remain independent.
Collective credit, denominator limits, corrections, project endings, and unrecovered evidence remain visible.
Unknown claim-capable projection surfaces fail closed.
The optimizing agent cannot grade its own patch or manufacture independent or human approval.
No public proofs, knowledge-bank, or public-claims route may exist.

evals.title: Exact G ancestry and frozen-family integrity
procedure: Verify the G base commit is an ancestor of the candidate.
Verify all A-N refs and strengths are recorded once.
pass_criteria: G ancestry is intact.
Fourteen frozen refs have unique branch and commit identities.
No frozen ref is used as a write target.
evals.remediation_hint: Restore G ancestry or repair the read-only family manifest.
cannot_establish: that every branch mechanism has been integrated well

evals.title: Append-safe intake without silent loss or private payload
procedure: Validate every receipt and canonical route.
Exercise dry-run, duplicate, protected-pointer, and malformed-input behavior.
pass_criteria: Receipts append rather than rewrite.
Duplicates are detected.
Private markers and protected URLs are rejected.
Integrated receipts resolve to canonical captures or research tasks.
evals.remediation_hint: Create the smallest public-safe receipt and route it without copying the private payload.
cannot_establish: that a submitted memory is independently corroborated

evals.title: Queryable lifecycle and auditable correction history
procedure: Query by record type and lifecycle dimensions.
Verify zero results differ from query failure and corrections remain traversable.
pass_criteria: Unknown filters fail closed.
Results use stable IDs and deterministic ordering.
The command is read-only.
Superseded wording remains auditable.
evals.remediation_hint: Repair the query contract or the missing correction path without creating another registry.
cannot_establish: that a retrieved claim should be selected for publication

evals.title: One canonical graph with valid states and evidence paths
procedure: Run the maintained knowledge-development gate.
Inspect graph, state, source, observation, task, and promotion integrity.
pass_criteria: The inherited local knowledge gate passes.
No broken reference, unsafe active projection, or competing canonical bank exists.
evals.remediation_hint: Repair the canonical relationship or hold the projection.
cannot_establish: independent judgment, human approval, or release authority

evals.title: Fail-closed projection coverage and cumulative-disclosure safety
procedure: Inventory every claim-capable route, metadata, data, content, and document surface.
Run public-safety and projection-integrity checks.
pass_criteria: Every discovered claim-capable surface is bound.
Unknown surfaces fail.
Protected evidence cannot render.
No prohibited route exists.
evals.remediation_hint: Bind the surface with an explicit policy or remove the unsafe projection.
cannot_establish: that a visually unobtrusive citation treatment is editorially optimal

evals.title: Corpus manifests, honest denominators, and non-additive controls
procedure: Verify retained population controls and source digests.
Check authored, repost, context, excluded, and unrecovered classes remain distinct.
pass_criteria: The inherited full-population eval passes.
No overlapping control is summed as an independent population.
Published counts retain denominator limits.
evals.remediation_hint: Repair the denominator or classification before strengthening interpretation.
cannot_establish: attendance, adoption, endorsement, reach, impact, or causality from platform counters

evals.title: Collective credit, role calibration, and outcome distinctions
procedure: Give a blind judge the exact candidate and frozen criterion.
Test direct action, team contribution, institutional response, public outcome, and causality separately.
pass_criteria: Jamie's documented action is not hidden.
Collective credit is not absorbed.
Artifact, delivery, use, handoff, adoption, decision impact, and causality remain distinct.
evals.remediation_hint: Strengthen the direct action and narrow the unearned collective or causal inference.
cannot_establish: private collaborator intent or undocumented division of work

evals.title: Chad-lens hiring clarity and future-facing offer
procedure: Ask a blind hiring judge what Jamie can own, toward what end, and what proof earns confidence.
Require one accurate referral sentence without apology or invented authority.
pass_criteria: The target role and owned work are legible.
Actor, action, usable result, and boundary are specific.
The future offer and next action are clear.
evals.remediation_hint: Make the strongest approved action and end more specific without inflating ownership.
cannot_establish: employer fit for every role or permission to publish a held claim

evals.title: Morse and Sack lenses preserve embodied and recursive intelligence
procedure: Test whether embodied, participatory, relational, and artistic intelligence remains connected to present work.
Test whether relationships become analysis, working form, and real-setting learning.
pass_criteria: The artistic, civic, technical, and social practices remain connected.
At least one concrete recursive systems sequence is demonstrable.
Interpretive language does not obscure the hiring path.
evals.remediation_hint: Restore one concrete threshold where embodied inquiry and recursive systems practice remain visible.
cannot_establish: literal endorsement by Margaret Morse or Warren Sack

evals.title: Human-readable dossiers and evidence-debt routing
procedure: Inspect every project dossier for conclusion, source or method, boundaries, and open research.
Verify material evidence debt has a canonical route.
pass_criteria: Project records are understandable without reading source code.
Survivorship, role, outcome, visual, and corroboration gaps remain visible.
evals.remediation_hint: Add the missing human-readable boundary or route the gap to the canonical ledger.
cannot_establish: that every private archive has been exhaustively reviewed

evals.title: Exact-candidate build, accessibility, and release evidence
procedure: Bind verification to the exact candidate fingerprint.
Check build, Docker, routes, metadata, keyboard use, reflow, contrast, and console state.
pass_criteria: The exact candidate has a passing repository contract and environment preflights.
Canonical routes pass at 320, 375, 768, and 1280 pixels.
Infrastructure failures remain not_observed rather than false passes.
evals.remediation_hint: Run the missing exact-candidate verification or fix the highest-severity observed failure.
cannot_establish: production deployment approval or live post-deploy success

evals.title: Grader separation and human authority remain honest
procedure: Reject stale or self-authored judgments.
Verify machine, independent, human, rights, and release authority remain distinct.
pass_criteria: The optimizer does not grade its own patch.
All judgments match the exact candidate and rubric.
Open human or release decisions keep complete readiness held.
evals.remediation_hint: Obtain the named external decision or report the candidate honestly as human-blocked.
cannot_establish: human approval, rights clearance, or release authority without the named human action
